turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Good morning, Mr. Tan. I'm Dr. Lim from the anesthesia team. Today, we'll go over some questions to prepare you for your laparoscopic gallbladder surgery. Let's start with your medical history. Can you tell me about your gallstones?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Ah, yes. Been having belly pains on the right side, especially after eating. Ultrasound showed stones, so doctor said remove it laparoscopically.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Understood. Let's move to your medications. You're on atorvastatin, metformin, and omeprazole daily. What about simvastatin?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Oh, I stopped that one already, doc. Was taking it at night, but surgeon said to stop before surgery, right?

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Correct. Now, about allergies. Your records say 'no allergies recorded,' but I like to double-check. Have you ever had reactions to antibiotics, especially penicillin?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Actually, yes! When I took penicillin for a throat infection years ago, I got a bad rash all over. But it wasn't written down, I guess.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Thank you for sharing that. We'll update your records immediately. Any other allergies or reactions?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: No, just that one. Never had problems with other antibiotics.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Good. Let's discuss your health conditions. You have hypertension and hyperlipidemia. How are they managed?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Blood pressure is okay with the meds, doc. Cholesterol too. But my weight... BMI 28, still struggling with that.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Noted. Have you fasted since midnight as instructed?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Yes, nothing since last night's dinner. Just water this morning for meds.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Excellent. Any previous surgeries or anesthesia issues?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Appendectomy when I was young. No problems then. Woke up fine.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Great. Lastly, can you walk up stairs without difficulty?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Yeah, can climb stairs no problem. Just slower because of the weight, lah.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Thank you, Mr. Tan. We'll use general anesthesia with a laryngeal mask, propofol, remifentanil, and vecuronium as planned. Desflurane will maintain your anesthesia. Any questions?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: No, doc. Just want to get this done and feel better.
